item.title: Crafting Audio Experiences
item.description:
Hi there! My name is Jakob and I am a technical sound and interaction designer. I am passionate about creating engaging interactive software experiences and systems/tools of all kinds and forms!

Check out my portfolio page and my reel above to see what I do, and navigate to the about page if you are interested in learning more about my journey with audio, up to now.

Feel free to reach out for a talk or for any questions - I’d be happy to hear from you!

item.title: Droemmefanger
item.description: Through live sound processing Droemmefanger captures and manipulates the real world sounds in real-time. This is done through live processing where recorded sounds is processed and replayed randomly and according to some specific rules which is defined in the code.
